title: Laredo Veterans Day Parade steps off Wednesday, Nov. 11 at 10 a.m.
excerpt: The Veterans Day Parade rolls through downtown Laredo on Wednesday, November 11, at 10 a.m. — starting at Jarvis Plaza and ending at San Agustin Plaza.
content:
Laredo will honor its veterans with a parade through downtown on Wednesday, November 11, starting at 10:00 a.m., the City of Laredo announced.

The parade is hosted by the Veterans of Foreign Wars (VFW) and Korean War Veterans. It will begin at Jarvis Plaza and conclude at San Agustin Plaza.

The city invites the community to line the streets, wave flags, and show appreciation for the men and women who have served in the nation's armed forces.

Source: City of Laredo.
